verses.en: I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
verses.pt: Bendirei ao Senhor em todo o tempo; o seu louvor estará continuamente na minha boca.
verses.en_web: I will bless Yahweh at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.
verses.en_bbe: <Of David. When he made a change in his behaviour before Abimelech, who sent him away, and he went.> I will be blessing the Lord at all times; his praise will be ever in my mouth.

verses.en: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.
verses.pt: No Senhor se gloria a minha alma; ouçam-no os mansos e se alegrem.
verses.en_web: My soul shall boast in Yahweh. The humble shall hear of it, and be glad.
verses.en_bbe: My soul will say great things of the Lord: the poor in spirit will have knowledge of it and be glad.

verses.en: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.
verses.pt: Engrandeci ao Senhor comigo, e juntos exaltemos o seu nome.
verses.en_web: Oh magnify Yahweh with me. Let us exalt his name together.
verses.en_bbe: O give praise to the Lord with me; let us be witnesses together of his great name.

verses.en: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
verses.pt: Busquei ao Senhor, e ele me respondeu, e de todos os meus temores me livrou.
verses.en_web: I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
verses.en_bbe: I was searching for the Lord, and he gave ear to my voice, and made me free from all my fears.

verses.en: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.
verses.pt: Olhai para ele, e sede iluminados; e os vossos rostos jamais serão confundidos.
verses.en_web: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.
verses.en_bbe: Let your eyes be turned to him and you will have light, and your faces will not be shamed.

verses.en: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
verses.pt: Clamou este pobre, e o Senhor o ouviu, e o livrou de todas as suas angústias.
verses.en_web: This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
verses.en_bbe: This poor man's cry came before the Lord, and he gave him salvation from all his troubles.

verses.en: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.
verses.pt: O anjo do Senhor acampa-se ao redor dos que o temem, e os livra.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.
verses.en_bbe: The angel of the Lord is ever watching over those who have fear of him, to keep them safe.

verses.en: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
verses.pt: Provai, e vede que o Senhor é bom; bem-aventurado o homem que nele se refugia.
verses.en_web: Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
verses.en_bbe: By experience you will see that the Lord is good; happy is the man who has faith in him.

verses.en: O fear the LORD, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.
verses.pt: Temei ao Senhor, vós, seus santos, porque nada falta aos que o temem.
verses.en_web: Oh fear Yahweh, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.
verses.en_bbe: Keep yourselves in the fear of the Lord, all you his saints; for those who do so will have no need of anything.

verses.en: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good thing.
verses.pt: Os leõezinhos necessitam e sofrem fome, mas àqueles que buscam ao Senhor, bem algum lhes faltará.
verses.en_web: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.
verses.en_bbe: The young lions are in need and have no food; but those who are looking to the Lord will have every good thing.

verses.en: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
verses.pt: Vinde, filhos, ouvi-me; eu vos ensinarei o temor do Senhor.
verses.en_web: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Come, children, give attention to me; I will be your teacher in the fear of the Lord.

verses.en: What man is he that desireth life, and loveth many days, that he may see good?
verses.pt: Quem é o homem que deseja a vida, e quer longos dias para ver o bem?
verses.en_web: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?
verses.en_bbe: What man has a love of life, and a desire that his days may be increased so that he may see good?

verses.en: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.
verses.pt: Guarda a tua língua do mal, e os teus lábios de falarem dolosamente.
verses.en_web: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.
verses.en_bbe: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from words of deceit.

verses.en: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
verses.pt: Aparta-te do mal, e faze o bem: busca a paz, e segue-a.
verses.en_web: Depart from evil, and do good. seek peace, and pursue it.
verses.en_bbe: Be turned from evil, and do good; make a search for peace, desiring it with all your heart.

verses.en: The eyes of the LORD are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.
verses.pt: Os olhos do Senhor estão sobre os justos, e os seus ouvidos atentos ao seu clamor.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.
verses.en_bbe: The eyes of the Lord are on the upright, and his ears are open to their cry.

verses.en: The face of the LORD is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
verses.pt: A face do Senhor está contra os que fazem o mal, para desarraigar da terra a memória deles.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.
verses.en_bbe: The face of the Lord is against those who do evil, to take away the memory of them from the earth.

verses.en: The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.
verses.pt: Os justos clama, e o Senhor os ouve, e os livra de todas as suas angústias.
verses.en_web: The righteous cry, and Yahweh hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
verses.en_bbe: The cry of the upright comes before the Lord, and he takes them out of all their troubles.

verses.en: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
verses.pt: Perto está o Senhor dos que têm o coração quebrantado, e salva os contritos de espírito.
verses.en_web: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is near the broken-hearted; he is the saviour of those whose spirits are crushed down.

verses.en: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.
verses.pt: Muitas são as aflições do justo, mas de todas elas o Senhor o livra.
verses.en_web: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.
verses.en_bbe: Great are the troubles of the upright: but the Lord takes him safely out of them all.

verses.en: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.
verses.pt: Ele lhe preserva todos os ossos; nem sequer um deles se quebra.
verses.en_web: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.
verses.en_bbe: He keeps all his bones: not one of them is broken.

verses.en: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.
verses.pt: A malícia matará o ímpio, e os que odeiam o justo serão condenados.
verses.en_web: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.
verses.en_bbe: Evil will put an end to the sinner, and those who are haters of righteousness will come to destruction.

verses.en: The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.
verses.pt: O Senhor resgata a alma dos seus servos, e nenhum dos que nele se refugiam será condenado.
verses.en_web: Yahweh redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will be the saviour of the souls of his servants, and no one who has faith in him will be put to shame.
